variety_description: High yielding, early maturity, short height, long slender variety suitable for transplanted and dry seeded cultivation under upland conditions. A short duration and drought tolerant variety developed by BINA and released in 2017 for planting in Aman and Aus season. Popular among farmers in the Barind tract of Bangladesh. Non-sticky cooked rice.  Tolerant to major diseases and insect pests
